name: Finance Pack
description: Automated invoice reconciliation, cash flow forecasting, financial statement analysis, and AR collections for small businesses and finance teams.

agents.name: Invoice Reconciler
agents.description: Matches supplier invoices and receipts against bank statement CSVs, parses line items, and flags discrepancies and missing receipts.

agents.name: Cashflow Forecaster
agents.description: Analyzes receivables, payables, and historical burn rate from bank CSVs to project 30/60/90-day liquidity and detect cash shortfalls.

agents.name: Financial Auditor
agents.description: Performs variance analysis and computes solvency and liquidity ratios from P&L, balance sheets, and SEC EDGAR 10-K/10-Q filings.

agents.name: AR Collections Specialist
agents.description: Scans aged accounts receivable reports, groups past-due accounts by risk tier, drafts professional reminders, and tracks payment commitments.
